You have been provided with the review-pr SKILL.md as your system prompt.

Execute the SKILL.md's complete workflow on PR #{pr}.

The workflow should:
  1. Collect full PR context: diff, linked issues, PRD/design/plan artifacts,
     CI status, prior review comments.
  2. Run multi-dimensional analysis (security, performance, correctness,
     error handling, code quality, test adequacy, consistency, risk).
  3. Ground findings in official documentation via Context7 / web search.
  4. Post inline PR review comments via gh CLI.
  5. Optionally produce a structured markdown report.

When done, print exactly: REVIEW_PR_DONE
Then surface: number of findings by severity (Critical / High / Med / Low / Info),
recommendation (Approve / Request Changes / Comment), and top 3 findings as
one-line excerpts.
